children: Solaris Energy Infrastructure completed the acquisition of Omega Foundation Services via a two-step merger, paying approximately $77 million in cash and issuing 3,599,199 Class A shares to the seller, Andrew Bennett, who agreed to a 180-day lockup and customary indemnities. The transaction closed on September 1, 2026, giving Solaris 100% indirect ownership of Omega. Concurrently, Omega entered a Master Lease with Bennett Acquisitions to secure properties essential to its operations, amending and restating prior leases. The deals strengthen Solaris’ infrastructure services platform and ensure operational continuity.
